const x = 3;
let n = 2;
console.log((-x) ** 2, -(x ** 2), x ** -2, 2 ** -x, (<number>x) ** 2);
console.log(++n ** 2, n++ ** 2, n);
let a = 5;
let b = 0;
if (a > 3 && (b = 1)) console.log('assigned', b);
const r = a > 1 ? (a = 2) : 0;
console.log(r, a);
a > 0 ? (b = 7) : b = 8;
console.log(b);
a = b = 4;
console.log(a, b, -(b = 6), b);

function greet(name?: string, greeting = 'Hello') {
  return `${greeting}, ${name ?? 'guest'}`;
}
console.log(greet(), greet('Ann', 'Hi'));

type Flags = { [K in 'bold' | 'italic']?: boolean };
const flags: Flags = { bold: true };
console.log(flags.bold, flags.italic);

type Scores = { [name: string]: number | undefined };
const scores: Scores = { ann: 3 };
console.log(scores.ann, scores.bob);

type Prefixed = { [key: `id-${number}`]: string };
const ids: Prefixed = { 'id-1': 'one' };
console.log(ids['id-1']);
